interaction: Answer a four-step problem finder (what's wrong, is water running, where, how urgent) to get honest first steps with a mini diagram — e.g. where the water meter usually is — and a pre-filled enquiry; then drag a ratcheting spanner (or use Tighten/Loosen or arrow keys) to seal a dripping pipe joint while a playful litres-saved counter climbs.
notes: Drips stop animating under reduced motion (the gauges still update). The suburb checker uses a fixed list of Newcastle, Lake Macquarie and Maitland suburbs. Call-out fees are sample prices.
